purpose: Full-source search document preparation; NOT a validated semantic graph.
publication_gate: Parent/second-agent review required before Azure publication.
projection_policy: HTMLParser strips tags/comments/declarations, decodes character references in normal data, retains text data and adds newlines at block tags. No whitespace trimming or normalization. This is NOT byte-verbatim transcript text and NOT HTML sanitization for browser rendering. Original parsed transcript UTF-8 bytes are retained exactly in correspondence.jsonl original_transcript and verified against original JSON and segment ledger.
offset_policy: Zero-based half-open Unicode character offsets into projection_text.
hash_policy: sha256:<lowercase hex>; text hashes are over UTF-8 encoded strings.
